definition.en: A reduction in the oxygen-carrying capacity of blood, commonly associated with low hemoglobin concentration.
definition.ps: دا د طبي زده کړې لنډه تشریح ده: A reduction in the oxygen-carrying capacity of blood, commonly associated with low hemoglobin concentration.

explanation.en: Anemia has many possible causes, including iron deficiency, blood loss, chronic disease, and inherited conditions.
